okvoice_primary.t: Voters narrow Oklahoma GOP gubernatorial field — Oklahoma Voice

races.note: Open seat. Jun 16 primary: R Drummond 26.3%, Mazzei 26.0% to Aug 25 runoff, Mazzei won 50.3-49.7 (2,047 votes); D Munson 74.9% outright. Wikipedia lists no independent/Libertarian nominees (not independently verified). No governor rows in records list.
